<!-- Thank you for contributing to JAC.  Five short fields; none needs more than a few lines.
     Please read CONTRIBUTING.md first if you have not. -->

## What and why
<!-- What does this change, and what problem does it solve?  Link an issue if there is one. -->


## Which modules
<!-- Which files under src/ does it touch?  JAC's own rule is one module per change where possible;
     if this touches several and cannot be split, please say why. -->


## Approved references
<!-- Does any file under test/approved/ change as a result?  List them, and please do NOT update them —
     leave them as they are.  Re-approving a reference is a physics decision and is made on the maintainer's side.
     Write "none" if the suite is unchanged. -->


## What was checked, and against what
<!-- Numbers, and the reference they were compared with: a published table, another code, an analytic limit,
     a sum rule, a gauge comparison.  "The tests pass" tells us the code still does what it did, which is
     necessary and not sufficient.  If agreement is partial, saying where it fails is more useful than silence. -->


## AI assistance
<!-- Briefly, where did an AI assistant contribute — tests, derivation, bug-seeking, code, documentation, none?
     There are no restrictions on the answer; it tells a reviewer where to read closely.
     A person should be submitting this pull request and be ready to answer questions about it. -->
